description: This PHP class 'EmployeeLanguageDecorator' provides a decorator/wrapper around the EmployeeLanguage entity, allowing easy access to related data such as fluency and competency, and facilitating linking EmployeeLanguage with Employee and Language entities via database references.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeLanguage entity, facilitating access to fluency, competency, and associations with Employee and Language entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLanguage entity.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Retrieves the fluency description based on the EmployeeLanguage's fluency code.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Retrieves the competency description based on the EmployeeLanguage's competency code.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to EmployeeLanguage by employee number.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates a Language entity to EmployeeLanguage by language ID.
